liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (2 other sources): The 6:22 Alabama Getaway comes from the Sony 220T FOB source; Alabama Getaway segues straight into Greatest Story Ever Told [3][8]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): The jam turns into a heavy-metal romp, with Jerry playing power chords; Jerry especially came to rock, with Bird Song, Shakedown, Eyes and even Black Peter singled out [13][19]
- **The Other One** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer calls the Other One a great performance; The Other One space is included within The Other One [6][14]
- **My Brother Esau** (1 review): Esau is one of the rough bumps in an otherwise high-energy show [19]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Eyes a great performance [14]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 other source): One More Saturday Night was the encore [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-08-20.151140.aud.lohr.vernon.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 174 min [1]
- **gd1983-08-20.148067.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 167 min [3]
- **gd1983-08-20.fob.sony220t.keshavan.miller.96387.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 167 min; rated 3.92/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the sound very good; Excellent audience recording with every part of the sound spectrum well defined; The set 2 disc change is seamless [5][19][22]
- **gd1983-08-20.150893.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: source not stated; 20 songs; 173 min [6]
- **gd83-08-20.neumann.dodd.12081.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min; rated 3.38/5 by 8 [8]. Said about its sound: The drums segment is missing from this recording, which the reviewer laments; Reviewer finds it sounds nice but doubts it is really an audience tape [14][17]
- **gd1983-08-20.111528.Sennheisser.daweez.d5scott.flac**: source not stated; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer and a taper friend were floored by the clarity and beauty of this recording [23]

## Around the show

- The band gets a bit too sloppy in the middle of the first half of set 2 [18]
- The show took place on an afternoon outdoors at Stanford Frost [22]
- Reviewer says shows from 8/20 to 9/24 form a special run across the western US, with mindbending playing [16]
- The band was fired up across this entire tour, not just this show [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-08-20.151140.aud.lohr.vernon.flac2496**: taped by Gesine Lohr; transferred by Matt Vernon; source: Nakamichi mics > Nakamichi deck > MAC [1]
- **gd1983-08-20.148067.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M [3]. Also: A Sony 220T source from Keshavan and Miller supplies the crowd plus patches in Eyes Of The World and Black Peter [3]
- **gd1983-08-20.fob.sony220t.keshavan.miller.96387.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rango Keshavan; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B) [5]. Also: Credit goes to Keshavan and Miller for this source; Neumann KM84 to cassette master to DAT to CD source supplies a one-second Man Smart (Woman Smarter) patch; Rango Keshavan lent his masters; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction of the patch source [5][22]
- **gd1983-08-20.150893.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: A Sony ECM-220t source from Keshavan and Miller supplies a 52-second patch in Drums [6]
- **gd83-08-20.neumann.dodd.12081.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD(Neumann KM 84Âs)>MC>DAT>CDR [8]
- **gd1983-08-20.111528.Sennheisser.daweez.d5scott.flac**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: Source: 2 Sennheiser 421 microphones (25 feet from stage-center) > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [9]
